description: Navigation-only excerpts of actual stationary-prefix and driving decisions; no raw camera tracks were recorded. Original navigation fields are retained unchanged. Pixel proxy is built only at test time and is explicitly not detector replay.

measured_geometry.notes: The reported rear overhang is 0.07 m. Runtime rear_overhang_m stays at the conservative envelope max(0.07, 0.42 - 0.335) = 0.085 m to cover the full reported 0.42 m length. The 0.015 m discrepancy is unresolved. Dimensions do not verify clearance, ground projection, motion or pose.

calibration_evidence.notes: Historical data only: assumes unchanged fixed camera and pure uncropped resize. Current pose and lane-edge coverage must be checked. This polygon does not cover both edges of the 1.23m lane. Not enabled for driving.

settings.notes: 2026-10-25 human measurements update body width to 0.30 m and overall length to 0.42 m; measured rear overhang 0.07 m is recorded separately from the conservative runtime 0.085 m rear envelope. Rear-axle-to-front extent is 0.245 + 0.09 = 0.335 m. See geometry.measured_geometry and its source record for wheel/tyre measurements and the unresolved 0.015 m length discrepancy. Existing lane, cone and camera settings are preserved. Clearance, ground/motion/pose validation remain incomplete; geometry.measured is not promoted.
